title: Forgiving Others
definition: Forgiving Others is the Christlike release of bitterness and personal vengeance because God has forgiven us in Christ.
summary: Forgiving Others is the believer's grace-shaped release of personal vengeance because God has forgiven in Christ.
christFocus: Jesus Christ purchased forgiveness for sinners and calls His people to extend mercy to others.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine focuses on interpersonal mercy. Forgiveness does not call evil good, remove every consequence, or require instant trust. It releases vengeance to God and seeks a heart free from bitterness because Christ has shown greater mercy.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because unforgiveness imprisons the wounded heart and poisons communities. At the same time, shallow ideas of forgiveness can ignore justice and safety. Biblical forgiveness is truthful, costly, and rooted in the cross.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Bring wounds to Christ rather than nursing vengeance alone. Forgive as an act of obedience and dependence, even when trust must be rebuilt wisely. Seek counsel when harm is severe or ongoing.
